name: Taisen Ren'ai Simulation: Trifers Mahou Gakuen
original_name: 対戦恋愛シミュレーション トリフェルズ魔法学園
source:
The game is a cartoon dating simulation in which the player have to compete againts other characters to win the affection of their friends. Depending of the conversation choices or if he wins the mini games the love meter will increase or decrease with each character. 

The game is divided into different stages, for example the first stage takes place in a snow place where they are located in a hotel and they can make snowmans, skiing, take walks, etc. The second stage takes place in a tropical place, they can go around the beach, go to the sea, etc. 

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/T/SLPS-03304.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
